artists.biography: Gleb Kolyadin (Gleb Alekseevich Kolyadin, Russian: Глеб Алексеевич Колядин, born July 11, 1989, Leningrad, Russia) is a Russian pianist, composer, and arranger who mixes progressive rock and jazz fusion with neoclassical styles. He has released music both as a solo artist and as a member of the prog duo iamthemorning. Read more on Last.fm. perplexity.description:
Released on 23 February 2018, Gleb Kolyadin is the self-titled debut solo album by the Russian pianist and composer, best known as one half of the atmospheric prog duo iamthemorning. The album marks a pivotal moment in Kolyadin’s career, stepping out from the collaborative context into a more personal and expansive musical territory. Musically, it blends jazz, rock, and progressive elements with neoclassical piano work, intricate arrangements, and subtle electronic textures. The compositions showcase Kolyadin’s virtuosic technique and his ability to merge complex rhythms with melodic accessibility, creating a sound that is both adventurous and emotionally resonant.

Gleb Kolyadin stands as a foundational release in his solo discography, establishing his signature style that would evolve on later albums like Mobula. The album received strong critical acclaim, with reviewers praising its originality, technical mastery, and emotional depth. It was lauded for its seamless fusion of genres and its ability to balance experimental tendencies with melodic clarity. Released on Kscope, the album solidified Kolyadin’s reputation as a leading figure in contemporary progressive music, earning a 10/10 rating from outlets such as The Prog Space and affirming his place as a distinctive voice in the genre.
